listings.title: Senior CRM Manager - Transformation (all genders)
listings.description:
The role

We are looking for a Senior CRM Manager - Transformation to make CRM Self-Service at HelloFresh a reality.

Our central Growth function has a clear vision: Enabling our local marketing and product teams to reach our customers directly, via push notifications, in-app messaging and emails. For this to work in an efficient and customer-centric way, the right guardrails, tools and knowledge need to be in place.

Your first mission is to design, launch and scale our CRM self-service model. You’ll do this hand in hand with our CreativeTech squad (Product and Engineering), who are building the future CRM environment in an AI-native way. You’ll work closely with the squad, and potentially be embedded in it. You’ll be the voice of CRM and of our internal users, helping define what this environment needs to look like so teams can send communications safely and independently.

This is 0-to-1 work in a highly ambiguous space where no one has been before: no playbook, no rules. AI and LLMs change fast and often, so you’ll think about what we need in the future, even if today’s models aren’t ready yet, and be prepared for when they catch up. The learning curve will be steep, but you’ll climb it on the go, together with the team. Our goal: protect our environment from the agents, and protect the agents from our environment. 

From there, your focus will follow where CRM needs it most. You’ll take on further transformation projects, so this role is for someone who enjoys building something new and then moving on to the next challenge.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

listings.title: Principal Security Engineer, Security Tribe
listings.description:
The role

We are looking for a Principal Security Engineer to serve as one of HelloFresh's most senior technical authorities in Security — shaping how we protect the company today while defining the security foundations we will need for the future.

This is not a Principal role defined by ownership of a single security domain. Your domain is HelloFresh.

You will operate at the intersection of technology strategy, security architecture, engineering and business risk, influencing some of the most consequential technical decisions we make. You will partner with senior Engineering, Product, Data, IT and business leadership to ensure security is not something applied after strategic decisions are made, but a fundamental input into those decisions. 

You think in systems, not Initiatives — and in years, not quarters.

Where others see an IAM issue, application vulnerability, endpoint incident or AI risk, you look for the architectural condition connecting them. You ask not only “How do we fix this?” but “Why can this class of failure exist at HelloFresh, and what should we change so that it becomes difficult by design?”

Your job is not merely to secure the systems HelloFresh has today. It is to influence what HelloFresh builds next, define the security architecture that makes it possible, and raise the technical capability of the organisation so that secure-by-default becomes a property of the company itself.

You will bring exceptional breadth across Cloud Security, Application & Product Security, Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, Detection & Response, Enterprise IT Security, IAM & Zero Trust, Endpoint/MDM, Governance & Risk, Third-Party & Supply-Chain Security, and GenAI Security — with the depth and judgment to challenge our strongest special

listings.description: Deine Mission Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen. Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde. Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben. Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch. Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender. Konkret: ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt. DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden. ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. listings.title: Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
listings.description: Was du bei uns machen wirst: TL;DR Zasta ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App Stores (schau selbst auf deinem Handy in der Kategorie Finanzen nach). Wir bauen kein Unternehmen über Headcount auf. Unsere Teams bestehen aus erfahrenen Expert:innen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit. Wir suchen einen Chief of Staff mit außergewöhnlich hohem Drive und analytischer Stärke , der direkt mit unserem CEO an den wichtigsten strategischen Themen von Zasta arbeitet. End-to-End Ownership: Von Analyse und Business Case über Partnerverhandlung und Scoping bis zu Go-live und messbarem Ergebnis. Top-Profil: Sehr starker akademischer Track Record und typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Erfahrung – z. B. Strategy Consulting + Operator-Rolle, Founders' Office oder General Management. Business-relevante Projekte: Neue Geschäftsmodelle, Partnerschaften, Marketing Channels, regulatorische Themen, Markterweiterungen und andere strategische Initiativen. Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau ist aufgrund unseres regulierten Steuerumfelds zwingend erforderlich. Starkes Gehalt + VSOP , ein klarer Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta (wenn dein Weg dich stattdessen zur eigenen Gründung führt, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit einem Angel-Ticket). Du bist für relevante strategische Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Business Impact verantwortlich. Achtung: Das ist keine klassische Stabs-, PMO- oder Koordinationsrolle. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, schaffst Struktur, entwickelst Business Cases, identifizierst und verhandelst mit Partner:innen und treibst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations bis zum Go-live. Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge baut und ins Ziel bringt, anstatt nur Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erarbeiten. listings.title: Senior Manager Accounting & Controlling (m/w/d)
listings.description: Die Chance Im Mittelstand wird das Rechnungswesen in Teile zerlegt und weitergegeben. Einer bucht, einer baut den Abschluss, einer spricht mit dem Unternehmer. Am Ende kennt niemand das Unternehmen ganz, und der Inhaber bekommt Zahlen, mit denen er nicht steuern kann. Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Für diese Unternehmen übernehmen wir das Rechnungswesen vollständig: die laufende Verarbeitung mit hohem Automatisierungsgrad, die handelsrechtliche Bilanzierung und darauf aufbauend Auswertung, Planung und Controlling. Du führst deine Mandate vollständig durch die Zahlen, vom laufenden Rechnungswesen über den Abschluss bis in das Gespräch, in dem der Unternehmer seine Entscheidungen trifft. Es gibt keine Schnittstelle, an der du übergibst. Du führst ein Team und berichtest an die Geschäftsführung. Was du verantwortest Rechnungswesen und Bilanzierung Verantworte das laufende Rechnungswesen deiner Mandate unter hohem Automatisierungsgrad und steigere diesen Grad weiter, statt Handarbeit zu verwalten. Dein Maßstab ist nicht, dass die Zahlen am Ende stimmen, sondern wie wenig manueller Aufwand dafür nötig war. Verantworte den handelsrechtlichen Jahresabschluss samt Anhang und Bericht als eigenständiges Ergebnis für den Unternehmer, nicht als Vorstufe der Steuererklärung. Definier, wann ein Abschluss abschlussfähig ist, und mach daraus einen Standard, der auch unter Fristendruck trägt, samt Vier-Augen-Regime in der Linie. Steuerung und Beratung Führ das Monats- oder Quartalsgespräch mit dem Unternehmer und übersetz die Zahlen in eine Handlungslinie. Dein Maßstab: Er kann danach entscheiden, nicht nur eine Zahl wiederholen. Bau Planung und Steuerung auf dem laufenden Rechnungswesen auf: Ergebnis-, Bilanz- und Liquiditätsplanung mit Szenarien, Forecast, Soll-Ist-Abgleich, Deckungsbeitrag.

That’s digital sovereignty, and Redpanda ADP is the infrastructure layer that makes it real. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is the delivery arm. We embed engineers directly with strategic customers and build the agents and integrations that turn ADP into owned outcomes. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the builder: embedded on-site, working inside the customer’s environment, writing the code that ships. This is not a solutions engineering role. You are not here to demo or advise. You are here to build — agents, integrations, data pipelines, and the infrastructure that runs them — alongside a customer team, in their environment, on their timeline. You Will: Build at the customer site. Write production-quality agents, integrations, and data pipelines on Redpanda ADP, inside the customer’s environment and codebase. listings.title: Commercial Associate
listings.description: About Hook We’re building the future of customer growth. At Hook, we use AI and Machine Learning to help businesses predict revenue with accuracy, drive customer loyalty, and capture massive value from their existing customers. We’re a Series A company who ranked 33 out of 100 on the Sifted fastest growing startups and we have raised $multi-million in funding from some of the top investors in Europe and the US (e.g. Balderton Capital and Lightspeed) and have an enviable list of customers that we’re working with including some of the fastest growing companies in the world. We’re looking for ambitious people that want to be part of our meaningful vision of changing how businesses engage with their customers, and of building one of the world’s leading workplaces for great people along the way. The Role: We're looking for people who are either: Serious about building a career in sales. Or coming from a different field and making a deliberate move into sales. Ultimately, we want someone who wants to progress quickly to be an Account Executive within 12 months. What makes this opportunity unique is that you're not just learning how to generate leads. You'll be trained across the entire sales process, from prospecting and discovery through to running demos, building business cases, and closing deals. You'll learn directly from our top sellers, work alongside experienced Account Executives on live opportunities, and gradually take on more commercial responsibility as you develop. At Hook, we believe great salespeople are made through a combination of ambition, curiosity, ownership, and exceptional coaching. That's why we've built a structured 12-month programme with a clear progression path to Account Executive, giving you the opportunity to go from learning the fundamentals to owning your own revenue target and doubling your earning potential. This isn't a stop-gap job. It's a genuine opportunity to fast-track your career in one of the most rewarding professions out there.

listings.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
listings.description: LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK - WITH FIELD TRAVEL AS REQUIRED ON-SITE: 5 DAYS THE LAST FRONTIER The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure. Arctic Research and Development (ARD) was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to own the design, build, and deployment of cold-hardened hardware — from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms. You’ll work from first principles to engineer real-world solutions that operate where failure isn’t an option. You’ll be responsible for end-to-end design, push hardware and material limits, and take your work into the field — from the workshop to the Arctic. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Design, test, and deliver Arctic-ready hardware from cradle to deployment for ARD’s product-line Drive materials choices, joinery, sealing, and reliability under thermal/mechanical stress Run cold-chamber and durability testing, along with Test Engineer, to ensure performance in sub-zero climates Integrate closely with electrical, software, and deployment teams (systems, software, GIS, RF)

The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. That means human iPSCs and other cell types that are hard to culture, taken from a vial on arrival to a validated, documented bank that a screening campaign can draw on. Most of the work is engineering. You will generate CRISPR-edited lines, including knockouts, knock-ins and endogenous tags, isogenic disease and corrected pairs, and inducible systems. You will differentiate iPSCs into neurons and other lineages and characterise them by immunostaining and imaging, then hand them on to the screening, imaging and computational scientists you work alongside. listings.title: ML Research Engineer - Member of Technical Staff
listings.description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. listings.description: Job title: Technical GTM Lead Location: London; full in-office working as default Start date: ASAP Reports to: CRO Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion Application deadline: 01/11/26 at 23:59 UK time ___________________________________________________________________________ Help put frontier AI to work in the real world Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations. We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world’s largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints. We’re also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government. We’re now looking for a Technical GTM Lead to become the technical centre of gravity for our go-to-market team. You’ll sit at the intersection of customers, sales, product, engineering and machine learning. listings.title: PDLC/SDLC Expert – Python & GenAI H/F
listings.description:
Capco France recherche un·e PDLC/SDLC Expert – Python & GenAI pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs de la banque et des services financiers dans l'optimisation et la transformation de leurs cycles de développement produit et logiciel.

Au sein de notre Practice Technology & Engineering, vous interviendrez à l’intersection du Software Engineering, de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle pour concevoir et déployer des solutions améliorant la qualité, la rapidité et la fiabilité du développement logiciel.

Vous travaillerez aux côtés des équipes Engineering, Architecture, DevOps et Product pour analyser les pratiques existantes, identifier les opportunités d’amélioration et accompagner l’évolution des méthodes de développement.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’intégration de la GenAI et des workflows AI-enabled au sein des cycles PDLC/SDLC, de la conception à la mise en production, en veillant à maintenir la supervision humaine, la sécurité, la traçabilité et les standards de qualité.

 

Vos missions :

  • Analyser et optimiser les cycles Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) et Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) afin d’améliorer la qualité, la productivité et la fiabilité des processus de développement.

  • Concevoir et développer des solutions et outils d’automatisation en Python, notamment pour les activités de développement, de tests, de validation et de maintenance logicielle.

  • Intégrer des capacités de GenAI et des workflows AI-enabled dans les pratiques d’ingénierie, notamment pour l’assistance au développement, la génération et la revue de code, la documentation et l’automatisation des tests.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Engineering, DevOps, Architecture et Product pour industrialiser les solutions, renforcer les pratiques CI/CD et accompagner leur adoption.

listings.title: Presales System Engineer, Territory - PACA (Remote: Marseille or Aix-based)
listings.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure, Inc. (formerly Pure Storage) is adding a Systems (Presales) Engineer to our Commercial district in France, covering the PACA region from Marseille or Aix-en-Provence.

This is a field presales role for someone with 5+ years of hands-on SE experience who enjoys owning a territory. You will partner with several Account Executives across a mixed portfolio: large regional accounts where you drive the technical agenda, public-sector organizations in health, social services and heavy industry, and a long tail of mid-sized companies where speed and pragmatism win.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the technical relationship across your territory: discovery, architecture, demos, proofs of concept and technical closure, on Everpure's Enterprise Data Cloud platform.
  • Take the initiative in large accounts: build activity, find new use cases, and create opportunities rather than wait for them.
  • Sell outcomes, not boxes: position services and consumption models (Evergreen//One, storage-as-a-service) credibly with IT and finance stakeholders.
  • Work day to day with your Account Executives and with channel partners in the region.
  • Own technical responses to RFPs and RFIs.
  • Contribute to a national SE team that shares knowledge and wins across districts.

Notre équipe Digital Repair recherche un·e Quality Engineer (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille (Campus).

L'équipe Digital Repair a pour mission de prolonger la durée de vie de nos produits sportifs grâce à des solutions numériques innovantes.

Composée de profils variés et passionnés (développeurs, product managers, designers), notre équipe relève le défi de l'économie circulaire chez Decathlon. 
En nous rejoignant, tu auras un impact direct sur la réduction de notre empreinte écologique tout en offrant une expérience de réparation fluide, fiable et accessible à nos utilisateurs à travers le monde.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 
En tant que Quality Engineer (f/m/d), tu seras le/la garant·e de la qualité des produits que nous mettons à disposition de nos utilisateurs. Tes missions principales seront :
* Accompagner les équipes de développement dans la mise en place et le maintien de l'automatisation des tests.
* Proposer et ajouter de nouvelles méthodes de test pour toujours garantir un plus haut niveau de qualité tout en réduisant les temps de delivery.
* Diffuser la culture de la qualité au sein de l'équipe et collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs dès la phase de conception.
* Suivre les indicateurs de qualité et assurer la fiabilité globale de nos parcours utilisateurs.

CE QUE TU APPORTES
* Tu as une expérience solide et confirmée en test d'applications Web et de micro-services.
* Tu maîtrises l'usage de l'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) appliquée au métier de la QA pour optimiser et innover dans tes méthodes de test.

listings.title: Medical Data Officer
listings.description: About the Job Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care, and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating bold solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand. This role is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a dynamic, ambitious team Medical Affairs. You will play a critical part in driving innovation and making an impact in the clinical research space, while enjoying a stimulating professional environment that encourages personal and intellectual growth. The Medical Data Officer works in close collaboration with the Study Medical Reviewer and participates in managing/reviewing the medical consistency of reported clinical data to ensure that medical data in database are accurate, reliable and analyzable. Main Responsibilities Study Setup Tasks * Protocol Review especially topics linked to safety management, specific data that could need to be coded, inclusion, selection criteria, study design, pathology and mechanism of action of the IMP * Database specification review and User acceptance test on eCRF, and Database validation tools used for medical review * Participate in identification of Important Protocol Deviation detection method and their implementation (specifications, and UAT) Study Conduct Tasks * Medical Coding of Adverse Events, medical and surgical history, other specific events and all treatments, including treatment indication. * Medical Review might check the medical data entered by the investigator using available tools and processes and can create manual queries for clarification, confirmation, or correction if needed. *Identify all non-serious adverse events according to strategy defined at the start of the study * Handle the extraction process to support data available for important study milestones Requirements About You At Excelya, taking audacious steps is encouraged , so we’re looking for individuals who are ready to grow with us and share our values. • Experience: J

Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Pourquoi Deliveroo ? Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent. Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre! Tes principales missions : Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l'expertise et l'attention au détail font toute la différence. Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech. Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data. Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d'amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté. Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l'attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires. Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible. Ton expérience et tes qualités : Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d'un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission.

listings.title: Fullstack Data Engineer
listings.description:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

As we expand our product portfolio and global presence, our Engineering department is seeking a Full-stack Data Engineer with a focus on AI and NLP. You’ll design, implement, and maintain highly available data pipelines that support our core products.

  • Support colleagues to achieve overall team success and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Embody Nozomi Networks' Cultural Pillars and our mission to protect what matters most with transparency and trust.
  • Collaborate within an agile team that emphasizes automation and the creation of high-quality, well-designed software.
  • Take ownership of user-facing features from inception to release and beyond.

To be successful in this opportunity you will have:

  • Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical skill.
  • Excellent problem-solving capabilities with a solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and concurrent programming.
  • Proficiency in a dynamic programming language such as Python or Ruby.
  • Knowledge of Machine Learning and NLP is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Docker and prior frontend development experience, including knowledge of JavaScript and React, is highly desirable.
  • B.S. or M.S. i

listings.description: The Destinus engineering team is seeking a Stress Engineer to support structural sizing and simulation with a focus on non-linear and thermomechanical analysis of solid rocket motor structures. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland. Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! Das Arbeitsumfeld ist trotz komplexer Anforderung menschlich und humorvoll, geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, schneller Umsetzung, langjährigen Mitarbeitern:innen und einer Führung durch Vertrauen. Wir verkaufen Gesundheit nicht nur nach außen, sondern leben sie auch nach innen. Du solltest diese Unternehmenskultur zu schätzen wissen und Dich bewusst dafür entscheiden. Wegen unseres stetigen und schnellen Wachstums suchen wir viele neue Kollegen:innen, die uns noch weiter voranbringen und gut ins Team passen. Wachse mit uns und profitiere von einem Umfeld, das Dir große Sicherheit und viele Chancen bietet. Deine Rolle Du möchtest einen Markt nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln und nachhaltige Partnerschaften aufbauen? Du verstehst Vertrieb als Beziehungsgeschäft mit Sinn – besonders im Gesundheitsumfeld? FormMed steht für hochwertige Mikronährstofflösungen, wissenschaftliche Qualität und das gemeinsame Ziel, Gesundheit nachhaltig zu verbessern. In einem respektvollen, lernbereiten Umfeld arbeiten wir täglich daran, medizinische Expertise zugänglich zu machen und echte Wirkung zu erzielen. Als Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) verantwortest du den strategischen und nachhaltigen Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebiets in der Westschweiz mit den Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis. Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und gewinnst neue Partner im Gesundheitswesen. Du repräsentierst FormMed als kompetenten und verlässlichen Partner gegenüber Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken
